quality.review_scope: Main and local supporting-information material preparations, size/loading contexts and selected structural/optical evidence. Analytical chemiluminescence reactions, calibration, oxidation challenges, snow-sample analysis, selectivity and mechanisms are outside this preparation scope; no complete-paper Reader.
missing_fields: No full unit cell or source atomic coordinates supplied.
IDs identify scoped source contexts, not author-assigned physical batch identities.
All eight centrifuged-supernatant compositions and residual concentrations are unreported; parent-mixture indexing does not transfer to the liquid fractions.
